# Reading collaboration regression report

这是独立合成的阅读协作测试文档，不包含产品历史记录或用户资料。

## Review observations

- Markdown headings and UTF-8 中文 must remain byte-exact after opening.
- A discussion annotation belongs to its original path and source digest.
- Moving or deleting the project copy must retain the open reading snapshot.
- The original fixture must remain unchanged across installed application restarts.

## Conclusion

The project copy is disposable. Source bytes, annotations and missing-path notices are checked through production renderer and IPC entry points.
